claims: Cameron Boozer's dad is Carlos Boozer.
Carlos Boozer is a former two-time NBA All-Star.
Carlos Boozer is an NCAA champion.
Carlos Boozer played in the NBA mainly with the Utah Jazz and Chicago Bulls.
Carlos Boozer is a Duke Athletics Hall of Fame inductee.
Carlos Boozer has twin sons Cameron and Cayden.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer play for Duke.
Carlos Boozer played in the NBA for 13 seasons.
Carlos Boozer earned two NBA All-Star selections in 2007 and 2008.
Carlos Boozer earned an All-NBA Third Team nod.
Carlos Boozer was a key player on Duke's 2001 NCAA Championship team.
Carlos Boozer was named the ACC Tournament MVP in 2002.
Carlos Boozer's former wife is CC Boozer.
Carlos Boozer and CC Boozer have twins Cameron and Cayden.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are 5-star basketball recruits.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer committed to play for Duke.
Carlos Boozer stated he wanted his sons to make their own college choices.
Carlos Boozer stated he did not want schools to recruit him as a parent
